title: The nullable-scalars-and-logical-types control, measured through reconstruct() as well
rationale: avro-nullable-scalars-and-logical-types-control is the third unqualified LOSSLESS Avro row, and logical types are exactly where genericRecordToMap converts representations - a decimal can come back as a ByteBuffer where the writer wants a fixed, and 'probably safe' is not a guarantee. Rather than leave the reconstruct() half of a published LOSSLESS row unmeasured, this row measures it. Same avsc and same datum as the control, so the only variable is the entry point.
catchesBugClass: A logical-type conversion that survives reconstructToMap and breaks under the writer. Because the encode is attempted rather than merely validated, it catches a representation the schema accepts by type but the encoder rejects by size or branch.
cannotCatch: It covers date, timestamp-millis and a nullable string only. It says nothing about decimal-on-fixed, uuid, or a logical type nested inside an array - avro-logical-types-erased-inside-arrays owns that case and does not reach reconstruct() either.

predicted.detail: No nested record, so the one-level copy is sufficient and the datum should validate and encode.
